| `nodeId` | The numeric ID of a single node. |
| `podId` | The numeric ID of a single pod. |
| `interfaceType` | One of `"svi"`, `"ethernet"`, `"loopback"`, `"port‑channel"`. |
| `infoType` | One of `"interfaces"`, `"status"`, `"statistics"`, `"errors"`. |

Then I can call the function for you.
